lines: In 1889, the Italian queen, Margherita, came to visit Naples along with her husband.
Queen Margherita heard that Raffaele Esposito cooked wonderful pizza.
So she asked him to come to visit her.
He was one of the most famous pizza makers in Naples.
She ordered him to make a pizza for her and her husband.
Esposito prepared a new type of pizza just for the queen.
It had the colors of the Italian flag: tomatoes (red), mozzarella cheese (white), and herbs (green).
He brought it to Queen Margherita.
The queen loved this new type of pizza, and she sent a thank-you letter to the chef.
To honor the queen, Esposito named it “Pizza Margherita.”
It quickly has become one of the most popular kinds of pizzas in Naples.
